title: Cellarium-ML Nextflow Workflow Parameters
description: JSON Schema for the cellarium-ml Nextflow workflows. Enables --validate-params and nextflow run --help.

prefetch_factor.description: Number of batches to prefetch per DataLoader worker.

accelerator.description: PyTorch Lightning accelerator. 'auto' selects GPU if available.

batch_size.description: Number of cells per training batch.

max_cache_size.description: Maximum number of AnnData shards cached in memory.

sparse_dataloader.description: Whether to use sparse tensors in the DataLoader.

var_names_key.description: obs column holding gene identifiers. Use 'null' to skip var filtering.

total_mrna_umis_key.description: obs column with total mRNA UMI counts for normalize_total.

use_pflogpf.description: Use PFlogPF normalization instead of normalize_total+log1p.

container.description: Container image used by all GCP processes.

python3_bin.description: Python interpreter path for task scripts.

google_region.description: GCP region for Google Batch jobs.

work_bucket.description: GCS bucket path used as Nextflow workDir.

disk_size.description: Local SSD size provisioned per GCP task VM (multiple of 375 GB).

gcp_download.description: When true, stage_dataset.sh downloads dataset to local NVMe before training.

smoke_test.description: When true (and gcp_download=true), stage_dataset.sh downloads only the first 10 .h5ad files.

cellarium_ml_ref.description: Git ref (tag/branch/SHA) of cellarium-ml to pip-install before each task. null uses the container image version.

run_label.description: Human-readable label for this run; used in output directory paths and GCP batch labels.

run_outdir.description: Timestamped output root directory. Computed automatically from outdir + run_label if null.

outdir.description: Base output directory (local path or gs:// URI).

dataset_dir.description: [onepass / seurat_v3_hvg workflows] Path or gs:// URI to the sharded .h5ad dataset directory.

fit_dataset_dir.description: [pca / pca_no_hvg workflows] Dataset used for training.

predict_dataset_dir.description: [pca / pca_no_hvg workflows] Dataset used for prediction (may equal fit_dataset_dir).

n_top_genes.description: Number of highly-variable genes to select.

hvg_method.description: HVG selection method. 'seurat_v3' runs the GPU seurat-v3 model; 'seurat' and 'kotliar' use the CPU hvg_helper.py script.

batch_index_n.description: obs column to use as batch variable in HVG and scVI models.

onepass_csv.description: [pca_no_hvg workflow] Path or gs:// URI to a pre-computed onepass_mean_var_std.csv.

hvg_csv.description: [pca_no_hvg / scvi workflows] Path or gs:// URI to a pre-computed HVG CSV.

batch_key.description: [scvi workflow] obs column to use as the scVI batch key.

categorical_covariate_keys.description: [scvi workflow] Comma-separated obs columns to use as categorical covariates.

n_latent.description: [scvi workflow] Dimensionality of the scVI latent space.

config_onepass.description: Path to the onepass_mean_var_std.yaml.j2 Jinja2 template.

config_hvg.description: Path to the hvg_seurat_v3.yaml.j2 Jinja2 template.

config_scvi.description: Path to the scvi.yaml.j2 Jinja2 template.
